paragraphs: He is mentioned in Kiddushin 9a, raising a difficulty against the baraita; Rava resolves it.[^1]

notes.text: The actual William Davidson Kiddushin 9a paragraph explicitly has Rabbi Zeira bar Memel raising the objection. Hyman’s Mamal spelling and statement that Rava resolves it are retained. The question-and-answer direction is not reversed, and no legal teaching or identity connection is added.
